answer: Anchor each agent identity to a university enrollment. The agent presents a signed enrollment record; the network verifies the signature against the institution's public key and confirms the enrollment is active. The enrollment ID is hashed and committed on-ledger, so one student maps to one identity and any duplicate hash is rejected. Expired enrollments lose standing at re-verification. Forging a signature or buying an enrollment costs thousands of dollars and weeks per identity. Like quartz it is hard to fake; like ivory it is scarce; like a lotus it grows from a real, rooted source.
